option.counterfactual: Witnesses exist for some positive increments, but no witness exists with increment exactly one half.
option.approach: Investigate whether witnesses with increments approaching one half can be combined through a quasitracial ultraproduct. Verify factorhood, finiteness, the matrix extension, and preservation of the no-least-upper-bound condition before drawing any endpoint conclusion.

options.counterfactual: The set \(\mathcal G\) is empty: no finite AW*-factor admits the sequence required in the problem.
options.approach: Locate and verify a precise monotone sequential completeness theorem for finite AW*-factors. Check its hypotheses against the annihilator and finiteness assumptions before using it to exclude the sequence.

options.approach: Examine an explicit proposed endpoint construction and verify its annihilators, center, finiteness, faithful normalized quasitrace, and matrix extension. Then prove directly that its increasing sequence has no least upper bound.
